question.text: Let <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> and <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> be two unit vectors such that <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>.</mo><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo></math> For some <math><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>R,</mi></math> let <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>c</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>×</mo><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced><mo>.</mo></math> If <math><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>c</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></math> and the vector <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>c</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> is inclined at the same angle <math> <mi>α</mi> </math> to both <math> <mrow> <mover accent="true"> <mi>a</mi> <mo stretchy="true">→</mo> </mover> </mrow> </math> and <math> <mrow> <mover accent="true"> <mi>b</mi> <mo stretchy="true">→</mo> </mover> </mrow> <mo>,</mo></math> then the value of <math> <mrow> <mn>8</mn><msup> <mrow> <mi>cos</mi></mrow> <mn>2</mn> </msup> <mi>α</mi></mrow> </math> is

solution.text:
c→=xa→+yb→+a→×b→

c→.a→=x and x=2cos⁡α

c→.b→=y and y=2cos⁡α

Also, a→×b→=1

∴  c→=2cos α ⁡a→+b→+a→ ×b→

c→2=4cos2⁡αa→+b→2+a→×b→2+4cos⁡αa→+b→.a→×b→
